explanation: Two parallel validation passes changed author-validation ledger records for 16 datasets and appended six declarative comparison specs, with findings under turbo-2026-11-15/. compare_author_results.mts now appends its R 4.4.1 review sentence to a regenerated output only when the spec was not pinned to the current regenerated bytes; every earlier spec pins a predecessor, so existing generated notes are unchanged. No pipeline, statistical model, bundle or retained producer changed; generated comparison records still need regeneration in the maintainer checkout.
